segments.normalizedSource: ```swift override func traitCollectionDidChange(_ previousTraitCollection: UITraitCollection?) { let currentDisplayGamut = self.traitCollection.displayGamut if (previousTraitCollection?.displayGamut == .SRGB) && (currentDisplayGamut == .SRGB) { // Resolution didn't change. Your code goes here. } else if (previousTraitCollection?.displayGamut == .P3) && (currentDisplayGamut == .P3) { // Resolution didn't change. Your code goes here. } else { // Resolution changed. Your code goes here. } } ```
